title: Police form task group to probe judge’s ambush in Zamboanga City

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Police activated a special investigation task group (SITG) to track down the gunmen behind the fatal ambush of a judge Thursday dawn in Zamboanga City, regional police officials said. Brig. Gen. Elmer Ragay, director of the Police Regional Office in Zamboanga Peninsula (PRO-9), created the task group to handle the investigation into the killing of Judge Joseph Wee Sit, presiding judge of Regional Trial Court (RTC) Branch 2 in Isabela City. The victim was ambushed around 5:25 a.m. along Tumaga-Putik Road in Barangay Tumaga, Zamboanga City. READ: Basilan RTC judge killed in Zamboanga City ambush […]...
